title: Settings persistence (save/load/corrupt-file defaults) has zero automated coverage
detail: Deliverable 4 / the flagged-for-verification binary format (magic, version, checksum, range clamps, defaults-on-failure, write-then-rename) is entirely untested. A broken checksum or range guard ships silently. P1 behaviour at 0% coverage.
recommended_fix: Add a harness/app test that round-trips settings_save/settings_load against a temp HOME: valid file, truncated file, bad magic/version, flipped payload byte (checksum), out-of-range mode/step — each must yield the documented result.

title: palcheck separation oracle has no committed negative leg — a synthetic too-close pair is never shown to FAIL
detail: The briefing's hard guard requires verifying the oracle bites (a too-close pair must fail). Only the positive leg (shipped tables pass) is committed; a neutered oracle (zeroed threshold, identity matrix) would pass CI silently. P0 core-error leg uncovered.
recommended_fix: Add a palcheck leg that injects a synthetic colliding pair (e.g. state_healthy == state_critical) through a11y_separation_check and asserts fails > 0 for each deficiency.

title: UI scaling: the x1.25 step and all scaled hit-tests are untested (only x1.00 and x1.50-draw are pinned)
evidence: demos/a11y_scale.dem:5: `a11y scale 150` (header: "the juice scene at UI scale x1.50 (the knob's max step)") — grep of demos/ shows no `a11y scale 125` demo/golden; and drive_parity fixes the view at defaults: `pal := rnd.palette_load()` / `view.palette = &pal` / `rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance)` — ui_scale stays 1.0, so no parity/hit-test ever runs against hud()-scaled rects (tray chips, settings rows, popover, QoS, demolish button)
detail: Behaviour 3 covers x1.00 (existing goldens) and x1.50 draw (a11y_scale golden) but x1.25 has no golden and no input/hit-test runs at any scale >1.00 — a draw/hit-test divergence introduced in one scaled rect helper is invisible. P1 at ~55% coverage.
recommended_fix: Add an a11y scale 125 demo + golden, and run the input-parity suite (or at least the settings-panel + demolish-btn scenarios) at ui_scale 1.25/1.50 so scaled hit-test rects are exercised.

title: Settings-panel parity scenario never asserts navigate/activate effects; modal suppression is vacuous; app-side adjust logic untested
detail: panel_row is captured but never asserted, so a no-op Settings_Navigate passes; Settings_Activate's real effect (effect_settings_adjust: palette cycle wrap, scale clamp 0..2, persist) runs nowhere in tests; no scripted frame would emit a world command even with the modal gate deleted.
recommended_fix: Assert panel_row after the navigate leg per device; add a frame that would produce a world command if the modal gate were broken; unit-test effect_settings_adjust's cycle/clamp or expose it to a harness check.

title: The 25/25 parity scenarios never run under any a11y mode — 'input parity holds under every mode' is unexercised
evidence:
pal := rnd.palette_load()
	view.palette = &pal
	rnd.view_compute(&view, 1280, 720, &cat.balance) — no palette_apply_mode, reduced_motion, or ui_scale is ever applied to the parity view (contrast harness/goldens.odin's apply_demo_a11y, used only for demo renders); run_input_parity iterates scenarios, not modes
detail: Acceptance requires input parity under every a11y mode. Palette/motion don't touch input rects, but ui_scale does (settings chip/row, tray chips, popover) — the parity suite pins only the x1.00 surface. The a11y demos prove sim-hash identity, not input parity.
recommended_fix: Parameterize drive_parity's view with the a11y mode and rerun the rect-driven scenarios (settings panel, tier_cycle, demolish buttons) at x1.25/x1.50; document palette/motion as rect-neutral.

title: Caption-strip scaling (and the settings chip/panel) never enter any T2 capture — scaled rendering is unpinned
evidence:
// modal owns the frame while open). Both app-layer only (the harness T2
	// capture path never calls draw_hud — the chip cannot shift a golden). — and the capture path draws only `rnd.draw_forecast_panel(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, preview)` / `rnd.draw_health_meter(&rc.view, health, rc.view.catalogs, health_on)` / `rnd.draw_crisis_banner(&rc.view, crisis, rc.view.catalogs, era, banner_y)` (no draw_audio_caption)
detail: The diff scales the caption strip via hud() (fs := rnd.hud(&app.view, 16)), but draw_hud is app-only, so the a11y_scale golden cannot pin the scaled strip, chip, or panel. Low risk (pure HUD chrome), hence note.
recommended_fix: Add one capture leg (or a palcheck-style rendered check) that draws the caption strip + settings panel at x1.50 and asserts scaled geometry, or document the gap as accepted.

title: Advisory test gate: FAIL
detail: P0: palette enforcement ~90% (oracle negative leg missing) + goldens 100% → P0 <100%. P1: reduced-motion ~90%, captions ~90%, scaling ~55%, settings-panel input ~65%, persistence 0% → ~60% (<80%). Overall across the 8 traced behaviours ≈ 67% (<80%). All three FAIL clauses trip.
recommended_fix: Land the persistence round-trip tests, the palcheck synthetic-collision leg, an x1.25 golden, and scaled-mode parity runs; that lifts P0 to 100%, P1 above 90%, and overall above 80% for a PASS.
